plan.title: pr:merge-ready can report CLEAN while unresolved Greptile inline P1 remains

narratives.Description: pr:merge-ready can report MERGE-READY while Greptile still has unresolved inline P0/P1 comments on the same HEAD SHA. Badge/summary counts alone are insufficient when open review threads remain.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary
On deftai/statusreport PR #120, after fix commit `3a277b7`, `task deft:pr:merge-ready -- 120` reported:

- Confidence 4/5
- Findings P0=0 P1=0 P2=0
- Result: MERGE-READY

Meanwhile Greptile had an **unresolved inline P1** on that same HEAD (`Path traversal via .. in owner/repo segments` on `server/src/register/github.ts`). A review-cycle poller treated criterion (3) as failed because of the open thread; the merge-ready gate did not.

## Expected
`pr:merge-ready` should fail closed (or at least warn) when Greptile has unresolved inline P0/P1 review comments on the current HEAD SHA, even if the summary badge counts are zero / check-run conclusion is success.

## Actual
Badge/summary counts showed P1=0 and the gate returned MERGE-READY, enabling atomic merge while an open security P1 thread remained.

## Impact
Agents following review-cycle + merge-ready can squash-merge with open Greptile P1s that arrived on the re-review of a fix batch.

## Refs
- https://github.com/deftai/statusreport/pull/120
- Comment id 3599505280 on that PR
narratives.UserStory: As a review-cycle operator, I want pr:merge-ready to fail closed when Greptile has unresolved inline P0/P1 comments on the current HEAD, so that agents cannot squash-merge with open security findings.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Update the packages/core/src/pr/merge-ready.ts module (and greptile probe helpers under packages/core/src/pr/) so unresolved inline P0/P1 review comments on the current HEAD SHA fail the merge-ready gate even when badge counts are zero.
2. Add a focused unit test under packages/core/src/pr/merge-ready.test.ts (and greptile.test.ts if needed) that fixtures the statusreport PR #120 class failure and asserts fail-closed evidence.
3. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry.

narrative.Acceptance: Given unresolved Greptile inline P0/P1 on current HEAD, when pr:merge-ready runs, then it does not report MERGE-READY/CLEAN solely from badge counts.
Given stale vs current HEAD reviews, when the gate runs, then only unresolved threads for the current HEAD SHA affect the verdict.
Given a fixture mirroring summary-clean + open inline P1, when tests run, then the merge-ready path fails closed.
